_about: What counts as one of the visitor's actions, the same everywhere: the All actions list and each actor's share of it (agentcake/api/actions.py), where a hand-off is (agentcake/detect/handoff.py, through timeline.py) and what a stretch of the evaluation's splices spans (agentcake/evaluation/splice.py); agentcake/detect/visitor_actions.py reads it. An action is the visitor's own input: a click, a key or typed input, a wheel. kinds names the raw event types (cake.js's raw records, docs/collect-format.md) that are one, and the kind of action each makes. A dblclick is none (its two clicks are), nor is a touchstart (a tap makes a click, and a finger's scroll makes scroll events). A scroll event (needs_cause) is the visitor's only when their own input caused it: one of caused_by at most cause_ms before it. A page that scrolls itself (back to where the reader was, an animation) makes none, nor does a script that scrolls the page, an agent's among them. Measured on the hand-off recorder's recordings: every one of the 1128 scroll events of 11 people came at most 197 ms after their own input (the 99th percentile; none came a second or more after it), and 41 of the 299 scroll events of the AI agents and hand-offs came with no input in the second before. A recording without raw input (rrweb only) holds no wheel and no key, so none of its scroll events counts.
